item.title: Drone strike sparks blaze outside nuclear facility in Abu Dhabi
item.description:
Emergency services in the United Arab Emirates responded to an electrical generator fire near the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant after a drone strike occurred outside the inner perimeter. According to a report by Reuters citing local officials, the incident in the Al Dhafra Region caused zero injuries, left radiological safety levels untouched, and did not interrupt essential systems.
